d: Short, wavy copper-orange hair is styled in a voluminous bob with a side parting. The eyes are a sharp, narrow shade of light blue with a confident, cunning expression on a mature face. The build is slender with an hourglass silhouette. The outfit consists of a dark navy blue corset with white lace detailing, a long red overcoat draped over the shoulders, and a long, dark patterned skirt with a high side slit paired with black fishnet stockings and black high heels. Signature details include a large black wide-brimmed hat adorned with orange feathers and flowers, multiple strings of white pearls around the neck, a black lace eye mask, and black opera gloves.
